text:
Rasial, the First Necromancer

​
Introduction
In order to fight Rasial you must complete the Alpha vs Omega quest. Rasial deals Necromancy and typeless damage, and can only be killed using Necromancy.
​
Positioning

⬥ The tile shown above serves as a safespot for the ghost wall mechanic.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This tile is ideal as it keeps you 5 tiles away for quicker 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For the soul obelisks, you may run 4 tiles west (toward obelisk), and 2-4 east.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Doing this allows  to kill one of the soul obelisks.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This is only recommended if you have the ruthless perk.
⬥ For an in-game example of the correct tile being used, click here.
​
Mechanics



















Dive
⬥ Before the last phase, Rasial uses  to avoid the player if the player stands within a 2 square radius (scythe range) of him.
    • It is not feasible to use  against him.
    • Getting this mechanic may cancel  bounces.
​
Conjure familiars
⬥ Rasial can conjure skeletal warriors  and putrid zombies  to attack the player.
    • Unlike the player, he can conjure multiple of each.
    • It's recommended to ignore them throughout the fight.
​
Soul stacks
⬥ Rasial can gain  and use  like the player, and holds up to 5 stacks, shown by green orbs under his health bar.
    • At 5 stacks, he shouts 'This is true power!' and uses . Flick  (+  if needed) to avoid taking heavy damage.
    • The rotations outlined below should skip this mechanic consistently.
​
Soul obelisk
⬥ At 700k HP, Rasial summons 2 soul obelisks with 12,000 HP each.
    • They each have a bar which fills repeatedly. Upon filling, Rasial will get a  stack.
    • It's recommended to ignore this mechanic and focus on DPSing the boss.
​
Spirit wall
⬥ Rasial summons a wall of 7 ghosts behind the player which moves forward, dealing heavy typeless damage upon contact.
    • If using movement abilities   to avoid this stay within 5 tiles of Rasial for 
​    • Standing next to the barrier will avoid ghosts entirely.
​
Spectral scythe
⬥ Rasial pulls the player to him and uses , shouting 'I will reap your soul!'
​
Phase 4
⬥ At 200K HP, Rasial jumps to the upper deck of the citadel and briefly becomes immune, remaining stationary and stopping all mechanics mentioned above.
    • Necrotic explosions will occur, following the player. If hit, players take heavy Necromancy damage. Rasial's auto attacks are also always empowered, dealing double damage and disabling protection prayers
